title: RTS Powerlifting Volume Block
author: Ibrahim Arab
desc:
This Powerlifting Program is based on Reactive Training Systems RTS Manual which written by Mike Tuchscherer. 
This MesoCycle is 3 weeks length focusing on hypertrophy for powerlifters and includes: Competition Exercises CE, Special Development Exercises SDE, Special Preparatory Exercises SPE and General Preparatory Exercises GPE. Also, every exercise is provided with instruction which is necessary to follow.
Please note that SDE, SPE and GPE are up to athlete preferences and able to be swapped. Also adding more GPE like accessories is up to the athlete preferences and Maximum Recovery Volume MRV.
This Program aims to achieve the Minimum Effectice Volume MEV for Beginner to Intermediate Powerlifter.
After finishing this block consider a Pivot week then search for “RTS Intensity Block” and start it.
Hope you enjoy the journey
Coach Ibrahim

ex.note:
Squat Competition Exercise
If RPE passes @8 reduce the load by 5%.
In any set you reach @10 with 5 reps, this is a Fatigue Stop and you should move to the next exercise.

Deadlift Special Development Exercise SDE.
Consider a suitable weight to achieve the target reps and don’t overshoot the RPE. 
Feel Free to swap to any exercise which focus on your Sticking Points.

Squat Special Preparatory Exercise SPE. 
Consider a suitable weight to achieve the target reps and don’t overshoot the RPE. 
Feel Free to swap to any exercise which activate your Quadriceps.

General Preparatory Exercise GPE. 
Feel free to swap to any accessory exercise with full consideration of your capacity and recovery volume.
